observations: Two black motorcycle engines are shown, lying on dirt ground.
Both engines have visible cylinder heads with cooling fins, carburetors, and various hoses and wires.
Photo 0 shows one engine from a front-three-quarter angle; the other engine is partially visible behind it.
Photo 1 shows both engines side by side, with the second engine more clearly visible on the right.
The engine on the right in photo 1 has a visible label on the cylinder head that reads 'KYMCO' and '150' — likely indicating brand and displacement.
The engine on the left in photo 1 has a similar label, but it is less clear; 'KYMCO' is faintly visible.
Both engines appear used, with dirt, grime, and some signs of wear or damage — such as a broken wire end on the left engine in photo 0.
No visible serial numbers or model plates are readable in either photo.
The watermark 'RIDERS MART' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on both images.

claims.evidence: The brand 'KYMCO' and displacement '150' are visible on the cylinder head in photo 1, but 'first grade' is a subjective quality claim not verifiable from photos. No evidence of condition, mileage, or service history.

risks.risk: Engine may be non-functional or have internal damage (e.g., seized, worn piston, cracked block).
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running, or a close-up of the crankshaft turning freely by hand, and inspection of the cylinder bore and piston condition.

risks.risk: Engine may be stolen or have a compromised serial number (if any).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine's serial number plate, if present, or a certificate of origin.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked bike and have hidden damage.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine's internal components (e.g., crankcase, cylinder bore, connecting rod) and a history of use or accident.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running or turning freely by hand.
Clear photo of the serial number plate, if any.
Photos of the internal components (cylinder bore, crankcase, piston).
response.reason: The brand and model (KYMCO 150) are readable from the cylinder head in photo 1, allowing for identification. The claim of 'first grade' is unverified but not disproven. Hidden risks include mechanical failure and salvage condition, which are priced conservatively as not working or salvage until proven otherwise. The item can be priced at its worst-case condition based on visible identity and known risks.
